description: This file provides an API client for managing codebase indexing operations such as checking if indexing is enabled, searching code, upserting files, retrieving manifests, and deleting files, specifically for the Kilo Code backend API.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Checks if managed codebase indexing is enabled for a given token and organization.

methods.name: searchCode
methods.description: Performs a search query in the managed code index with branch preferences.

methods.name: upsertFile
methods.description: Uploads or updates a file in the code index using multipart upload.

methods.name: getServerManifest
methods.description: Retrieves the server manifest containing metadata about indexed files for a specific branch.

methods.name: deleteFiles
methods.description: Deletes specified files from the code index.
